feed.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026 — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: Every article on the warrant, and where each one stands.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Town Meeting, 2026-09-03
entry.summary: Transfer from the Winter Recovery Assistance Program (WRAP) special revenue fund to supplement the FY27 Lunenburg public schools operating budget, for restored middle school sports and transportation (Article 3, Motion A) — passed

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Select Board, 2026-09-01
entry.summary: Establish a special revenue fund, seeded with $36,000 from the WRAP funds, for Article 3. — passed 5-0-0

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Stormwater Task Force, 2026-08-31
entry.summary: Agreed the warrant article should include enough financial/rate substance for voters to understand the choice, but should not include a draft bylaw.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Personnel Committee, 2026-08-31
entry.summary: Committee will place a placeholder warrant article (and formally vote at a future meeting before September 17) to reserve space for these bylaw changes and for salary/comp consulting funding.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Trust Fund Commission, 2026-08-27
entry.summary: Have town counsel review and reword the previously submitted bylaw before it goes to the select board and finance committee for the special town meeting warrant.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Finance Committee, 2026-08-27
entry.summary: Defer Article 3 to Town Meeting. — passed

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: School Committee, 2026-08-26
entry.summary: The school committee will support the spirit of whatever the citizens' petition (warrant article 3) proposes, if funded from a new town source outside the schools' own budget, and will spend it as requested if appropriated at the special town meeting. — passed

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Select Board, 2026-08-18
entry.summary: The board will make its recommendations on the three special town meeting articles at its September 1st meeting, after hearing the School Committee and Finance Committee.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: , 2026-08-17
entry.summary: RTF Bylaw: the commission directed that the Town Manager be contacted for Town Counsel support in the warrant article (recorded in the agenda notes column, no vote recorded)

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Finance Committee, 2026-08-13
entry.summary: Opening, pledge of allegiance, announcements (Aug 27 public hearing, Sept 3 special town meeting)

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Stormwater Task Force, 2026-08-12
entry.summary: Task force will pursue a non-binding straw poll article (not a binding bylaw vote) at the fall town meeting on operating-budget versus utility funding, pending confirmation of the warrant timeline with the Town Administrator.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Select Board, 2026-08-10
entry.summary: to include Article 1 submitted by the School Department on the warrant — passed 5-0

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Planning Board, 2026-08-10
entry.summary: Hold the common-driveway/dwelling-unit-count bylaw change until after the state legislature acts on a possible statewide duplex-by-right mandate, then add it to the May 2027 town meeting warrant.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Board of Assessors, 2026-08-05
entry.summary: The board will table the veterans' (Clause 22) exemption increase for the September warrant and instead target the November town meeting, to allow time to inform the public.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Select Board, 2026-08-04
entry.summary: TCP/Brooks House will remain a standing weekly select board agenda item rather than being tied to a fall town meeting article.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: , 2026-08-03
entry.summary: PAC will wait for the November Town Meeting regarding including a PAC warrant

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: School Committee, 2026-07-29
entry.summary: Amend the previously approved warrant article to request $418,056 for the FY27 School Department operating budget and submit it to the September 3, 2026 Special Town Meeting. — passed unanimously

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Select Board, 2026-07-28
entry.summary: History of the $300,000/$325,000 roof-repair appropriation, its double-appropriation error, and correction at the most recent annual town meeting

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Select Board, 2026-07-27
entry.summary: Call a special town meeting for Thursday, September 3, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. at the Lunenburg Middle High School Auditorium, per the citizens' petition, and open the warrant July 28, 2026 with it closing 5:00 p.m. Friday, August 7, 2026. — passed unanimously

entry.title: Now following: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026
entry.summary: Every article on the warrant, and where each one stands.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Finance Committee, 2026-07-23
entry.summary: The next two Finance Committee meetings will be focused primarily on the additional special town meeting and its warrant articles.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Select Board, 2026-07-21
entry.summary: The chair will meet with town counsel to clarify special-town-meeting procedure for the citizens' petition, and the board will post a meeting for Monday July 27 to set the date of the special town meeting.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: School Committee, 2026-07-15
entry.summary: Approve the warrant article to raise and appropriate an additional $350,000 (and no cents) for the FY27 school operating budget, for submission to the Select Board for the November special town meeting — not audible (roll call heard as mostly "I" with at least one "No" from Ms. Gilman; chair stated "the motion is the ayes" but the full count was garbled)

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Select Board, 2026-07-14
entry.summary: Town manager/staff (Director of Planning, with facilities director input) to draft the select board's overdue report on Brooks House sale or long-term lease options, targeted for completion by the fall town meeting.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, September 3, 2026: Planning Board, 2026-07-13
entry.summary: Director will look at whether a common-driveway bylaw amendment (limiting units per lot / clarifying ADU treatment) can be folded into the editorial corrections planned for the November special town meeting warrant
